title: refreshCheckpoints lacks stale-response guard; checkpoint_restore lacks session-ownership check
notes: Partially fixed — remaining part per 2026-09-29 re-check: e6d1c576 added a generation guard in useProductRecovery.ts:77-98, so a late response from an older session no longer overwrites the list. Two problems remain. First, on a session switch the previous session's rows are not cleared (the reset happens only when sessionId === null, :81-84), so they stay rendered and clickable until the new fetch resolves. Second, the backend still has no session check: checkpoint_restore_impl (ipc/checkpoint.rs:110-125) checks only the project (db5b8c34), and useChatSession.ts:829 sends only checkpointId. In that window a same-project sibling session's checkpoint can be restored while the chat reloads the current session.
repro: On a project with sessions S1 and S2 that both have checkpoints, switch from S1 to S2 and click restore on an S1 row before checkpoint_list(S2) resolves: the S1 snapshot is restored while S2's chat is shown
